d: Enjoy all goals and match highlights from Uzbekistan vs Italy in Group E of the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026. Italy completed a perfect group stage with a 3-1 win at Aspire Zone in Doha as Tommaso Casagrande, a Federico Croci penalty and Thomas Corigliano put them 3-0 up by half-time, before ten-man Italy conceded a late consolation to Sukhrob Sadirjanov. Italy top Group E with nine points, while Uzbekistan finish third and must wait to see if they advance as one of the best third-placed teams.
